_comment: Sidecar metadata for fixtures/cursed_finance_export.csv. Pinned expectations the bronze→silver→gold cascade asserts against. Regenerate the CSV with `python scripts/generate_cursed_csv.py`; this sidecar describes the curses + the contracts they test.

encoding.rationale: Excel-export-from-Western-locale; UTF-8 fails on byte 0xe9 (é in cp1252). Connector's deterministic candidate list reports 'cp1252' after UTF-8 fails.

expected_classification.rationale: Source carries one or more PII column-name hints, so policy gate defaults the resource to PII classification.

expected_anomalies.rationale: in-band sentinel for missing CRM-merge rows; silver replaces with null before stats.
Excel formula error preserved through the export.
VLOOKUP miss + Excel formula error mixed into a numeric series.

expected_silver_normalizations.description: Bronze surfaces 2 identical header rows (Excel sin); silver collapses to 1.
Re-encode cp1252 → utf-8 at the bronze→silver boundary so downstream parsers don't need a custom decoder.
Replace any cell whose stripped value matches an Excel error token (#REF!, #N/A, #VALUE!, #DIV/0!, #NAME?, #NULL!) with empty so a 99%-numeric column infers as numeric.
expected_silver_normalizations.evidence: Q3 Rev (final)(USE THIS) and net_revenue infer as float dtype after silver

expected_silver_normalizations.description: Excel-style column labels collapse to lower_snake_case ids. The literal 'Q3 Rev (final)(USE THIS)' routes to 'q3_rev_final_use_this' — pinned by Seed-S1 chatter so phenomenon-gap detector matches.
Two datetime columns (recorded_at tz-naïve + recorded_at_utc tz-aware) describe the same logical event. Silver picks the tz-aware UTC variant; the naïve column is preserved as bronze provenance.
Replace -9999 with null in customer_count after sentinel anomaly is logged.

expected_kpi_proposal.rationale: Gold's KPI heuristic picks the first revenue-shaped numeric column when a date column is also present. After silver normalization the cursed CSV has both.

demo_arc_role.beat: F1 Beat 2-3 (default local source connect → first KPI proposal)
demo_arc_role.seed_dependency: Seed-S1 chatter (cursed_csv_chatter.jsonl) references the literal Q3 Rev label so phenomenon-gap detector at Beat 6 matches concretely.
